# Fig S4 : Probability Distortion Function in Gains
# Display the probability distortion function mean for each individual and the mean of all individual means in gains and losses

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- Fonction de distorsion de probabilité ---
prelec_function <- function(P, alpha) {
  exp(-(-log(P))^alpha)
}

P_values <- seq(0.001, 1, length.out = 1000)

# --- Moyennes individuelles par singe et classe ---
individual_params <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(monkey, elo_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_alpha = mean(alpha_graw, na.rm = TRUE),  # α+
    .groups = "drop"
  )

individual_means_df <- individual_params %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    distortion_values = list(sapply(P_values, prelec_function, alpha = mean_alpha)),
    P_value = list(P_values)
  ) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(distortion_values, P_value))

# --- Moyennes globales par classe ---
global_means <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(elo_class) %>%
  summarise(
    global_alpha = mean(alpha_graw, na.rm = TRUE),  # α+
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    distortion_values = list(sapply(P_values, prelec_function, alpha = global_alpha)),
    P_value = list(P_values)
  ) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(distortion_values, P_value)) %>%
  mutate(color = "blue")

# --- Texte pour les moyennes globales α+ (affiché sur les panels) ---
annotation_data <- global_means %>%
  distinct(elo_class, global_alpha) %>%
  mutate(
    label = sprintf("α+=%.2f", global_alpha)
  )

# --- Graphique avec panels par classe ---
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = individual_means_df, 
            aes(x = P_value, y = distortion_values, group = monkey), 
            color = "darkgray", alpha = 1, size = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = global_means, 
            aes(x = P_value, y = distortion_values, color = "skyblue"), 
            size = 1.2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  geom_text(
    data = annotation_data,
    aes(x = 0.8, y = 0.1, label = label),  # ajuste x et y selon ton graph
    hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 5, color = "black", fontface = "italic"
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  facet_wrap(~elo_class, scales = "fixed", nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "p", y = "w(p)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 26),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 26),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 16),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm")
  )

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- Fonction de distorsion pour les pertes ---
prelec_function <- function(P, alpha) {
  exp(-(-log(P))^alpha)
}

P_values <- seq(0.001, 1, length.out = 1000)

# --- Moyennes individuelles par singe et classe ---
individual_params <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(monkey, elo_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_alpha = mean(alpha_lraw, na.rm = TRUE),  # α-
    .groups = "drop"
  )

individual_means_df <- individual_params %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    distortion_values = list(sapply(P_values, prelec_function, alpha = mean_alpha)),
    P_value = list(P_values)
  ) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(distortion_values, P_value))

# --- Moyennes globales par classe ---
global_means <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(elo_class) %>%
  summarise(
    global_alpha = mean(alpha_lraw, na.rm = TRUE),  # α-
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    distortion_values = list(sapply(P_values, prelec_function, alpha = global_alpha)),
    P_value = list(P_values)
  ) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(distortion_values, P_value)) %>%
  mutate(color = "orange")

# --- Texte pour les moyennes globales α- (affiché sur les panels) ---
annotation_data <- global_means %>%
  distinct(elo_class, global_alpha) %>%
  mutate(
    label = sprintf("α-=%.2f", global_alpha)
  )

# --- Graphique avec panels par classe ---
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = individual_means_df, 
            aes(x = P_value, y = distortion_values, group = monkey), 
            color = "darkgray", alpha = 1, size = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = global_means, 
            aes(x = P_value, y = distortion_values, color = color), 
            size = 1.2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  geom_text(
    data = annotation_data,
    aes(x = 0.8, y = 0.1, label = label),  # ajuste x et y si besoin
    hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 5, color = "black", fontface = "italic"
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  facet_wrap(~elo_class, scales = "fixed", nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "p", y = "w(p)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 26),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 26),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 16),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm")
  )
```
